description: Done when: `greenhouse status` loads greenhouse.toml (repo path, plan prefix, wip.implement, wip.open_prs, quota.five_hour_max, quota.weekly_share, verify commands, per-stage model/turn budget) and prints every bead in the plan with its stage label, read via `bd list --json` behind an adapter interface with a fake for tests. go test/vet/gofmt clean; workspace.dsl matches imports.
title: Skeleton: config + status

description: Done when: internal/stage exposes Next(stage, event) -> (stage, action) covering spec/implement/verify/review/parked/learn/done, including retry-once-then-park on verify failure and reject -> learn. No I/O, table-driven tests cover every transition and every invalid one.
title: Stage state machine (pure)

close_reason: this PR; e2e: one real spec session on a throwaway bead: prompt delivered first try, pinned sonnet/low, sentinel + GREENHOUSE-EVENT parsed to spec-done
description: Done when: internal/launch renders prompts/<stage>.md (bead id, Done when, spec, turn budget, rules: nugit context @12000, trailers, draft PR, sentinel) and starts it with `agent-deck launch -worktree -b -c claude -g greenhouse -assert-done`; completion is read from `agent-deck session children --json`/inbox. Adapter + fake; one manual end-to-end run of a spec stage on a throwaway bead recorded in the close reason.
title: Launcher: stage sessions via agent-deck

description: Done when: internal/gate reads `agent-deck usage --json` (statusLine ingest), blocks on five_hour_max / weekly_share, falls back to reactive park-until-reset when the reading is missing/stale, and enforces wip.implement and wip.open_prs (gh pr list, greenhouse label). `greenhouse doctor` reports whether statusLine ingest is wired. Table tests for every gate.
title: Gates: quota, WIP, open-PR backlog

description: Done when: internal/verify runs the configured commands in the PR worktree (default: go build, go test, go vet, gofmt -l, nugit pr-render -fail-on fail), captures a bounded log, and returns pass/fail; failure feeds the log to one implement retry, then parks. Includes the ADR-0005 plan-scope check: the PR's diff under .beads/plans/ may change only its own bead's line (and only to close it). No LLM. Tests with a fake runner.
title: Verify: deterministic checks

description: Done when: `greenhouse tick` is idempotent and crash-safe, `run` loops ticks with a lock, --dry-run prints the decision without acting, and every stage run appends to .greenhouse/ledger.jsonl. Completion is polled (session children --json + the session's final message, parsed strictly), with no notify-daemon dependency (ADR-0006); doctor downgrades the daemon check to a warning. The scheduler creates the `greenhouse` label and applies it to every stage PR, stops a session once its result is collected (so WIP frees up), enforces a hard wall-clock limit per stage session (turn budgets are advisory only), wires internal/verify (base = origin/main after rebase; retry count from ledger records), and runs ParseUsageLimit on every stage output. Run state stays local (ADR-0005); the export also strips started_at. Then label gr-boot-7.. factory:approved and let greenhouse run its first step unattended. BOOTSTRAP THRESHOLD — from here greenhouse builds itself.
title: Loop + ledger: greenhouse tick/run (bootstrap threshold)

acceptance_criteria:
1. `greenhouse report [-config path] [--json]` is a new subcommand listed in usage/help; unexpected args exit 2; a missing/empty ledger prints zero counts and exits 0. Test: cmd/greenhouse report test over a fixture ledger.
2. Quota per merged PR: for each bead whose review record has outcome "merged", sum over all its records the 5h and 7d deltas (After-Before, clamped at 0, records with nil readings skipped and counted as "unknown") and print per PR (PR number, bead, 5h pts, 7d pts, unknown-run count) plus mean. Unit test with nil/negative deltas.
3. Cycle time per bead: first record Start to the merged/rejected record End (open beads: first Start to last End, marked open); print per bead plus median. Unit test.
4. Park rate and reasons: parked = beads with a needs-human/spec-vague outcome; rate = parked beads / beads with any record; reasons grouped by count (Reason text). Usage-limit stops reported separately (count, not parks). Unit test.
5. Retries: per bead the max Retries / count of verify-fail records; totals and distribution. Reject reasons: rejected records grouped with Reason text. Timed-out runs counted. Unit test.
6. Memory usage join, per stage run (LLM stages only, records with Session): read .nugit/.cache/usage.jsonl at the repo's common root (git rev-parse --git-common-dir parent; plain file read via a small internal/memory adapter, no nugit import; malformed lines skipped; missing file = no data, not an error). Match a record to a usage line by AgentSession == ledger Session when any line carries that id; otherwise by Branch == launch.DefaultBranch(bead, stage) and Time in [Start, End]. Source "hook" lines are not context calls. Per run report: context calls (source cli|mcp), calls before the session's first commit (first commit time on the branch via `git log`, behind a fakeable interface; no commit = all calls count as before; unknown = field omitted, not zero), empty bundles (decisions+lessons+references+glossary+working_memory+path_history==0 and !spec), unresolved paths (Component==""). Aggregates over all runs. Unit tests for both join modes, mixed modes, and unattributable lines.
7. Comparison: split stage runs (or beads, one rule documented in code) into "loaded context" (>=1 context call) vs "none", and for each group print n, verify retries, park rate, merged vs rejected, review rounds (review-stage records / verify-pass passes per bead; defined in code comment). Minimum sample const (default 5 per group, `-min-sample` flag): if either group is below it, print both groups' counts and the line "too few runs to compare (need N per group)" and NO rates/conclusion; --json emits the counts with "comparable": false and no rates. Tests at n=min-1 and n=min.
8. Output: plain text (tabwriter, matches status/doctor style) and --json with a stable documented schema (snake_case, arrays never null). Test: golden plain output and json round-trip.
9. Pure aggregation lives in internal/report (no I/O, no clock); I/O in internal/memory and cmd. internal/report has no import beyond ledger/stage. workspace.dsl has components report and memory and edges cli->report, cli->memory, report->ledger, memory->launch (if DefaultBranch used); README/DESIGN mention the command.
10. Verify: `go build ./... && go test ./... && go vet ./... && gofmt -l .` clean; `nugit pr-render -base main -head HEAD` has no fail findings. Bead gr-boot-7 closed in the PR and only its line changes in .beads/plans/.
description: Done when: `greenhouse report` rolls up the ledger: quota used per merged PR, cycle time per bead, park rate and reasons, retries, reject reasons. It also measures whether scoped memory is used and whether it helps: for every stage run it joins the nugit usage log (.nugit/.cache/usage.jsonl, matched by branch and time window, or by session id when the log carries one) and reports context calls, calls that happened before the session's first commit, empty bundles, and unresolved paths. It then compares outcomes for runs that loaded context against runs that did not (verify retries, park rate, merged vs rejected, review rounds). Below a minimum sample it prints the counts and says it is too few runs to compare, never a conclusion. Plain text + --json.
design:
Add:
- internal/report/report.go (+_test.go): pure. Build(recs []ledger.Record, usage []memory.Use-or-own types, firstCommit map, opts) -> Report struct with json tags: Merged[] (quota), Cycle[], Park{Rate,Reasons}, Retries, Rejects[], Memory{Runs[],Totals}, Comparison{Loaded,None,Comparable,MinSample}. Plus Text(w, Report) renderer. Owns the join and the min-sample rule so they are testable without I/O. Define its own input type for usage lines to avoid importing memory (keeps edges minimal).
- internal/memory/memory.go (+_test.go, testdata/usage.jsonl): adapter. ReadUsage(repo) ([]Line, error) reads the nugit log tolerant of malformed lines and unknown fields; FirstCommit(ctx, runner, repo, branch, since) (time, ok, err) via `git log --reverse --format=%cI` on the branch, behind the same runner interface cmd uses so tests fake it. Resolves common root via `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`.
Change:
- cmd/greenhouse/main.go: add "report" case + usage text; new cmd/greenhouse/report.go (+ report_test.go) with flags -config, --json, -min-sample; loads ledger via ledger.Open(cfg.Repo).Records(), calls memory + report, writes output. Exit 1 on read errors, 2 on bad args.
- .nugit/architecture/workspace.dsl: components report, memory; edges listed in AC9.
- README.md / docs/DESIGN.md: one paragraph on `greenhouse report` and its small-sample rule.
- .beads/plans/gr-boot-7 line only, via scripts/beads-export.sh; bd close in the PR.
Notes: ledger has no branch, so branch = launch.DefaultBranch(bead, stage); ledger Session equals nugit's agent_session (AGENTDECK_INSTANCE_ID) when set, which is the preferred join. Review rounds are derived from ledger records (no schema change). No new ledger fields needed; do not change internal/stage.
title: Report: greenhouse report

acceptance_criteria:
1. Rejection reason capture: ghCLI.PR requests `reviews,comments`; PR.Reason is the body of the most recent non-empty review OR PR comment (by submittedAt/createdAt), so `gh pr close -c "why"` and a review both work. Test (github_test.go): parsePR over fixtures with review-only, comment-only, both (latest wins), neither ("").
2. A review-stage record for a CLOSED PR has outcome "rejected" and Reason = that text (existing fallback text when none), and stays in the ledger. Test (tick_test.go): closed PR with a comment -> ledger Reason equals the comment; bead moves to stage:learn; `greenhouse report` still lists it under rejects.
3. Learn gets the rejected PR: launch.Request gains PR int and HeadRef string; prompts/learn.md tells the session to read `gh pr diff <PR>` and `gh pr view <PR> --comments`, names the rejected branch, and shows the lesson file format. Learn without a PR is a Render error. Tests (prompt_test.go): learn prompt contains the PR number, branch, `gh pr diff`; Render errors when PR==0.
4. Scheduler passes the review record's PR and branch into the learn launch request (via ledger.LastPR and the PR's HeadRef, falling back to omitted branch only if gh cannot resolve it -> bead parks needs-human). Test (tick_test.go): learn launch request carries PR and reason.
5. Learn output check (deterministic, no LLM, ADR-0001): after a learn-done result and before the ledger record is written, the scheduler finds the learn PR by head branch feature/<bead>-learn via a new GitHub.PRByBranch and requires: PR is open and draft; its changed files are all under .nugit/lessons/ and at least one is added; every added lesson file has front matter `status: proposed`. Any failure records outcome needs-human with the reason instead of learn-done (bead parks). Pure check function (no I/O) takes the file list + contents. Tests: pass; no PR; ready (not draft); touches a non-lessons path; lesson with status: active; zero lesson files.
6. The accepted learn-done record stores the learn PR number in Record.PR (no new ledger field), so the human can find the draft lesson PR from `greenhouse status`/ledger. Test: record.PR == learn PR.
7. Lesson shape: prompts/learn.md requires the nugit lesson front matter (schema_version, id LESSON-<slug>, type: lesson, scope listing the touched components, status: proposed, created, provenance.commit = rejected PR head sha, confidence: low) plus Trigger / Insight / Keywords body. The session never sets status: active or runs `nugit ratify`; the human ratifies by merging and `nugit ratify`. Test: prompt contains each field name and "nugit ratify".
8. The learn-done transition still parks the bead (existing stage test unchanged); internal/stage is untouched.
9. workspace.dsl in sync (new import edges only if added); docs/DESIGN.md learn row and README mention the draft-PR lesson and the deterministic check.
10. Verify clean: go build ./... && go test ./... && go vet ./... && gofmt -l . ; nugit pr-render -base main -head HEAD has no fail findings. gr-boot-8 closed in the PR; only its line changes in .beads/plans/.
description: Done when: a PR closed unmerged with a review comment triggers a learn session that writes a status: proposed lesson under .nugit/lessons/ (scoped to the touched components) on its own draft PR; the human ratifies. Rejection reason recorded in the ledger.
design:
Already built, do not redo: stage Review+Rejected -> Learn (internal/stage), review() recording the rejection and Reason in the ledger (cmd/greenhouse/tick.go), launchReason feeding Reason to learn, prompts/learn.md skeleton, learn config. Gaps to close:
Change:
- cmd/greenhouse/github.go (+github_test.go): request `reviews,comments`; parsePR picks the latest non-empty review/comment body (time-ordered) as Reason; add PRByBranch(ctx, branch) (PR, error) using `gh pr list --head <branch> --state all --json number,state,isDraft,headRefName,files`; extend PR with Files []string. Update the GitHub interface and the fake in tick_test.go.
- internal/launch/prompt.go (+prompt_test.go): Request gets PR int and HeadRef string; Render errors for learn when PR<=0.
- prompts/learn.md: add rejected PR number/branch, `gh pr diff`/`gh pr view --comments` steps, exact lesson front matter and body shape (copy field set from an existing nugit lesson), forbid status: active / nugit ratify, branch is feature/<bead>-learn, title the PR "lesson: <slug> (from #<PR>)".
- internal/learncheck/learncheck.go (+_test.go) NEW pure package (no I/O): Check(files []File{Path, Added bool, Content string}, draft, open bool) error enforcing AC5. Add component + cli->learncheck edge to .nugit/architecture/workspace.dsl.
- cmd/greenhouse/tick.go: in launch (learn case) pass PR (ledger.LastPR) and HeadRef (gh.PR) into launch.Request; in collect, when a learn run reports learn-done, call gh.PRByBranch + learncheck.Check, fetching added-file contents via `git show origin/<branch>:<path>` through s.runner; on failure rewrite the event to needs-human with the check error; on success set Record.PR. Keep it idempotent (read-only gh/git).
- docs/DESIGN.md, README.md: short note on the learn flow and the check.
- .beads/plans/gr-boot-8 line only via scripts/beads-export.sh; bd close in the PR.
Notes: the learn PR is created by the session, not the scheduler; whether it carries the greenhouse PR label (and so counts toward wip.open_prs) is a decision for implement: prefer NOT labelling it so lesson PRs never block implement launches, and say so in a comment. Do not change internal/stage. Rejected PR branch may be deleted after close: use `gh pr diff` (works for closed PRs), not the branch; in the provenance use the PR's headRefOid if available via gh pr view --json headRefOid.
title: Learn stage: rejection -> nugit lesson candidate

description: Done when: a dedicated unprivileged user on the always-on build host (not in the docker group, key-only SSH) runs greenhouse under a systemd unit in a capped slice, with agent-deck, Claude Code (Max login), nugit and bd installed; the laptop sees its sessions via `agent-deck remote`; statusLine ingest is wired so the quota gate is live.
title: Run on the build host

description: Done when: a greenhouse.toml for the first external customer repo (verify = that repo's own prechecks + the nugit gate; scope = what the build host can verify) drives its approved beads to draft PRs, and that repo's evaluation step has numbers from greenhouse report.
title: First external customer

description: Done when: an agent-deck conductor for the greenhouse host is set up from a versioned instructions file in this repo (conductor/), watches parked beads and the ledger, and for every park notifies the human (urgent for needs-human, info digest otherwise) with the question and a drafted answer; it never moves beads, merges, approves or launches stages (ADR-0006). Heartbeat pauses when idle. One real park observed end to end: park -> notification -> human unpark -> bead resumes the stage that parked it (ADR-0010).
title: Conductor for parks and notifications
